findings.expected: Reject unsupported financial quantities regardless of prefix/suffix/no-space/Arabic-percent typography; do not whitelist ticker/year when the local context is monetary or a ratio.
findings.required_fix: Recognize currency prefixes, adjacent suffixes and supported percent glyphs; fail closed for ambiguous quantity formatting rather than call it a bare year. Keep manual semantic review and all withholding; no natural-language parser can certify financial meaning.
findings.existing_draft_impacted: No such invented amount found in the current99paragraphs; this is an enforceable guard defect demonstrated with synthetic inputs.

findings.expected: Reject invalid row calendar/quarter identifiers; do not create a period label for them.
findings.required_fix: Validate supported fiscal-quarter range and civil start/end dates before label generation; check range consistency where present. Do not fabricate missing dates, infer issuer calendar, or change production measurement policy.
